name: Propranolol
summary: Propranolol. Classification: Other central nervous system medication.
generalRisks: This entry does not contain a complete risk or interaction assessment. Missing information or an absent interaction warning does not mean that a substance or combination is safe.
metabolism: Extensive first-pass metabolism includes CYP2D6 aromatic hydroxylation, side-chain processing and direct glucuronidation. CYP2C19 also participates. Most metabolites are eliminated in urine.
